ADD_NOTE.label: Note
ADD_NOTE.description: Writes a note on the lead for the counsellor, labelled AI.

CREATE_FOLLOWUP.label: Follow-up
CREATE_FOLLOWUP.description: Schedules a follow-up for the counsellor. Never a second one while one is open.

ESCALATE.label: Escalation
ESCALATE.description: Flags the lead for a counsellor to look at now, with the reason.

UPDATE_STATUS.label: Status change
UPDATE_STATUS.description: Moves the lead's CRM status. Never to Converted; Lost and Not interested need a note that explains why.

SCHEDULE_AI_CALL.label: AI call
SCHEDULE_AI_CALL.description: Queues an AI voice call in calling hours, at most 3 a week. Never after a wrong number or a do-not-disturb.

panel.footnote: An action runs on its own only after a person has approved enough of that same type. The kill switch stops all of them, a lead marked Do not automate gets drafts only, and the holdout group gets nothing.
